title: juicecraft — pub 15 s
music_key: F minor (Fm – Db – Ab – Eb, one chord per bar once the drop hits)

sections.name: HOOK
sections.music: no drums; sparse filtered pluck motif, airy pad very low; tension

sections.name: PRESS
sections.music: riser peaks (noise sweep + pitch up) from 1.5 to 3.0; hard cut of everything at 2.98

sections.name: DROP_REVEAL
sections.music: DROP at 3.0: four-on-the-floor kick every beat, sub bass, offbeat hats, clap on beats 2&4 (3.5, 4.5, ...)

sections.name: PROOF
sections.music: full groove continues; pluck chord stabs; energy steady-high

sections.name: REAL_SITE
sections.music: groove continues, add a rising arp in the last bar (11.0-12.5) to build into the end

sections.name: END_CARD
sections.music: drums stop at 12.5; reverse-cymbal swell 12.5->13.0; FINAL HIT at 13.0 (big chord + sub boom + impact); long ring-out with reverb; fade to silence by 14.95
